title: Back Rank Both Ways
setup: Black has a rook on e1 and a bishop on d1 sitting on your back rank while its king waits quietly on g8.
hint: Both sides have a weak first rank. Count which one falls in fewer moves.
explanation:
## The Idea

Black is a move away from mating you, which is exactly why {{Rb8+}} is right. {{Re8}} is forced and {{Rxe8#}} lands first. In a race, the only number that matters is who checks first.
